answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 39619 Country: Pakistan Title: We are regular in our prayers, sawm. I feel anyone have done black magic on my family (Allah knows best). Question: Though I also recite Manzil and other Duas nothing is working out for us. Could you please suggest and guide me that what should I do in my problems. Answer ID: 39619 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 449/462/N=1433) Your other family members should also recite Manzil after Fajr and Maghrib in the same way as you recite. Also after Fajr and Maghrib salah and at the time of going to bed, you should recite three Quls (Surah Ikhlas, Surah Falaq and Surah Nas) three times and blow over your body. Also at three times of meal (breakfast, lunch and dinner) recite Surah Falaq and Surah Nas 11-11 times with durood 7-7 times before and after and blow over meals and then eat. Practice the above mentioned act regularly with full attention along with your other family members. In-shaAllah, it shall bring lots of benefits. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
